source_scope: Existing complete 156-record holdout catalog and its fixed eight original PDF pages; no new sources or training facts
purpose: Source-supported compositional parameter queries as a separately reported targeted evaluation
admission: A natural parameter/configuration decision with explicit source scope
At least two semantically necessary source facts, not duplicated presentations
At least one necessary computation beyond lookup/projection/assembly: explicit pairing, typed predicate, range check, or source-supported configuration assessment
A necessity witness explains how dropping a fact/constraint changes the returned information or decision; call count alone is not admission
No literal answer injection or record-ID selection in program
Independently answered from original pages before reference comparison; explicit AI identity
Full reference replay and source checks; complete frozen catalog and same runtime operations
authoring_policy: At most three submitted questions per family; source limitations may reduce count. Repairs clarify evidence/meaning, not model score. No replacement candidates after model outputs.
question_forms: Comparison/filtering, configuration pairing, range/bound/combination-support judgments according to actual source content; quotas are not a requirement to invent an unsupported operation
source_review: Non-author AI first reads question-only and archived original pages, saves/seals own answers, then reads author reference; uncertainty recorded

evaluation.original_24: Unchanged task contract and independent primary report
evaluation.supplement: Separate fixed denominator; report all questions and source-family counts, paired C_domain minus A_domain, completion and cost
evaluation.same_source_dependence: Shares four families and source facts with original 24; not additional independent source families
evaluation.failed_reference_or_token_checks: Resolve implementation/question ambiguity before freezing; retain failure records; no silent truncation
